desc: Lua 5.4 sandbox: run a chunk with stdin and argv, read its stdout.
usage: POST /v1/run {"svc":"cxlua","code":"print(1+1)"} or op lua{code,stdin}. Standard libraries; io.read/io.lines read the framed stdin; arg[0]="<code>"; require searches /lib of the job fs. Uncaught error: message + stack traceback on stdout, exit 1; os.exit(n) exits n. Deterministic os.time/os.date.
out: program stdout (uncaught error: traceback on stdout, exit 1)

tests.in_text:
{"code":"local a, b = 7, 3
print(a + b, a - b, a * b, a // b, a % b, a ^ b, 7 / 2, -7 // 2, 1 << 10, 0xF0 & 0x3C)
local s = 0
for i = 1, 100 do s = s + i end
print('sum', s, math.type(s), math.type(2.0), math.maxinteger + 1 == math.mininteger)
"}

{"code":"local s = 'The quick brown Fox'
print(s:upper(), '|', s:lower(), '|', #s, s:find('quick'), s:sub(-3), s:reverse())
print((s:gsub('(%a)([%w_]*)', function(a, b) return a:upper() .. b:lower() end)), ('abc'):rep(2, '-'), s:byte(1), string.char(72, 105))
"}

{"code":"local text = 'Contact: ada@example.com, linus@kernel.org; phone +44 20 7946 0958.'
for m in text:gmatch('[%w%.]+@[%w%.]+%.%a+') do io.write(m, ' ') end
print(('555-0100'):match('^%d%d%d%-%d%d%d%d$') ~= nil, text:find('phone'))
print(text:match('(%+%d+) (%d+) (%d+) (%d+)'))
print(('2026-01-15'):match('(%d+)-(%d+)-(%d+)'), ('COLOR'):lower():match('colou?r') ~= nil)
"}

{"code":"local t = 1767270645
print(os.date('!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', t), os.date('!%A %d %B %Y', t), os.date('!%j %U %w', t))
local d = os.date('!*t', t)
print(d.year, d.month, d.day, d.hour, d.min, d.sec, d.wday, d.yday, d.isdst)
print(os.date('!%Y-%m-%d', 0), os.date('!%H:%M', 86399), os.date('!%Y-%m-%d', 1709164800))
"}

{"code":"print(pcall(error, 'plain message'))
local ok, e = pcall(error, { code = 42 })
print(ok, type(e), e.code)
print(pcall(function() local x return x.y end))
print(select('#', pcall(error)), xpcall(function() error('deep') end, function(m) return 'handled: ' .. m end))
"}
